title: Necromancer Plane of Sky Tests

== Checklist == [[File:Drakis_Bloodcaster.png|right|200px|thumb|]] '''Note:''' Most quests in the Plane of Sky require two items. One of those items will be a wind rune and can be found on any mob as a random drop in the Plane of Sky. The second item you need is from an island boss, they are rare drops. Some quests require a third ''Efreeti'' weapon which is also attained from island bosses in the Plane of Sky. '''To reach the quest room find the ('''[[Key Master]]''') near where you zoned in on island 1 and purchase an [[Efreeti's Key]]. It is free and looks like a [[Jade]]. After you have the key left click on the teleportation pad at the North point of the island, around {{Loc|Plane of Sky| 1600, 520}}.''' You only need to buy the key one time and it will be saved to your character. '''Find Drakis Bloodcaster and Hail him. He will tell you about the quests he has to offer. Reading his dialogue is optional and you can simply hand him your quest items.'''{{CheckboxList}}

    ==Quest Start== Talk to Drakis Bloodcaster in the [[Plane of Sky]]. You say, 'hail Drakis Bloodcaster' :''Drakis Bloodcaster says 'Greetings, dark one. Are you ready to begin? '' You say, 'I am ready to begin' :''Drakis Bloodcaster says, 'Then choose, necromancer. Do you wish to test your will, or your fortitude? I can conduct the tests of [flight], [power], and the [mind] to test your will, along with tests of the [heart], [hands], and [finger], to test your body. Stop wasting my time, and choose.'' == Necromancer Test of Flight == You say, 'flight' Drakis Bloodcaster says, 'So, you wish to start upon the test of flight? So be it. You must return to me a griffon's beak and a wind rune lena to reap your rewards. May the darkness guide your steps.' '''Reward:''' {{:Bloody Griffon-Hide Wrist Guard}} {| class="eoTable3" !
